name: Binastra Corporation Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未公布涉及业务板块扩张、新增、缩减或出售的公告，所披露的公告主要为股份分拆上市、股息派发、季度业绩及股东大会相关事项。最新一季（2026-07-31）营收同比增长65.9%，净利润同比增长78.1%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any expansion, new business, reduction, or disposal involving its business segments. The announcements disclosed mainly relate to share subdivision listing, dividend payments, quarterly results, and general meetings. For the latest quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue grew 65.9% year-on-year and net profit grew 78.1% year-on-year.
